steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Now where did I end up this time?!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: A waterfall?!
Pepe sees the same boy by the waterfall with his head down, washing something.
She quickens her steps in a bid to get the boy to notice her, and realizes he has grown taller and more mature since she last saw him.
The boy has become a young man.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Okay, enough! I don't care who you are, just let me leave... you...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You're hurt? Your face...

steps.name: Injured Youth
steps.text: Don't worry, sister. Most of the blood is the enemy's.

steps.name: Injured Youth
steps.text: The battlefield was more complicated than I expected, but they were no match for me. I won.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: Zubayr, I went to a temple in the Arsalan rainforest and got a blessed amulet for you.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: I pray it can protect you from harm.

steps.name: Injured Youth
steps.text: I'm not afraid of wounds, sister. These scars prove I have grown.
Pepe looks down and spots a longsword lying horizontally by the half-kneeling youth.
Several streams of fresh blood flow from the sword down into the nearby pool, dyeing the water pink.
Pepe turns her head and sees the girl behind her with a gentle smile on her face, but also concern in her eyes.
She turns back only to find the scenery around her has changed once again.
Within the rainforest, the youth holds up a dagger, turning it over as he inspects it.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: Congratulations. You'll be leading Father's garrison from tomorrow.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: This was the job you dreamed of, so why do you seem so unhappy?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: I don't know either. This commander's dagger is too light compared to the work and suffering I went through for it.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: What about you, sister? Are you not glad for me?

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: No, Zubayr. I'll only be glad when you are too.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: The books you spent countless days and nights on. Did you find anything?

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: Zubayr, Sargon's history extends past what we can imagine, and we lack a complete record in our manuscripts.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: I plan to compile a volume that records past events that have been missed or omitted. Hopefully...

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Hopefully...?

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: Hopefully, it will complete the account of Sargon's history.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: That will be a thick book... there are so many people you'd need to include.

steps.name: Gentle Girl
steps.text: Father has agreed to my idea, and has promised to help me.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Very Nice. I see we've both achieved what we wanted.
Pepe watches the boy sheathe his dagger as he smiles at his sister.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Where am I this time?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: When does this one take place...?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Zubayr... why do you seem upset?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: That Kuranta from the east has changed Father into a much different man.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: All these years, Father had remained stoic, even in the face of uprisings and challenges from various tribes. Time and again, he would reorganize his troops and fly his banners.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: When Father sliced his enemies apart with his sword, even the warm blood that spurted from their necks could not melt the cold gaze behind his mask.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: But that Nightzmora... when Father fought him, I could almost see sparks—not just from their clashing weapons, but also in his eyes.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: I had never seen him look at anyone with such fervor.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Zubayr, I can sense it... our father's passion for our country has long since faded.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: I heard some worrying news. Father plans to invite Kharanduu Khagan down south to wage war against those invisible foes.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: You're going with them, are you not?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Those strange enemies have already been encroaching on our land, bit by bit.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The Shah... you're both children of the Shah...
As she follows the youth's gaze toward the far horizon, the distant land suddenly gets pulled right before her.
Pepe sees a barren desert devoid of green as her eyelids are buffeted by sand.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...The Foehn hotlands...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: How are you feeling, Zubayr?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: I'm fine, sister.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: I'll need to remove your bandages to reapply the medicine. Bear with me, I'll be quick.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: It's alright, I feel no pain.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: How can that be... When they carried you back here, your entire body was charred.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: What should I do, Zubayr...? Father is missing and you're the only kin I have left.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Brother has taken the throne, but we do not share the same mother. Your military achievements have already made him wary.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: That historian... is he treating you well?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Yes... With his help, the volume is already half-done. Perhaps I could manage to see it complete within my lifetime.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Careful not to overwork yourself.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: It is my promise to Father... Even if I fail to complete it, the child within me will continue my work. One day, it will recount everything that has happened here to future generations.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: It will be a bridge across the vastness of time, connecting the readers with those recorded over the great river of time.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: I hear they plan to build a cenotaph for Father.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Before he left, Father confided in me about a trove filled with the land's treasures. He instructed me to reveal its location only to the descendants of the Nightzmora.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Brother will not be happy when he learns of this.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Sister, you chose to record Father's every word and action to memorialize his departure, while I chose to protect everything he left behind.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Father has only just left, and already war rages among the western tribes... I must go and quell the unrest.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: But how... how will you go in your current condition?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: A gemstone artisan from Arsalan told me he could preserve my consciousness into gemstones inscribed with special circuits.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: The craftsmen who created the Zhayedan are also willing to build me a new body.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Did you already decide on this before telling me about it, Zubayr?

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: Sister, I do not wish to be bed-bound forever...

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Zubayr, I only wish for you to be happy, and nothing more.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Promise me you'll never forget this.

steps.name: Quiet Youth
steps.text: I promise.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Where... am I?)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (So dark... is anyone here?)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Wh-Why can't I talk?)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Drat, I can't move at all. My limbs are all bound so tightly.)
Are you ready? I'm about to remove the brain.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Brain?)
Administer more sedative, his pulse is still beating rather rapidly and I need him to be calm.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Are you talking about my brain?!)
A cover is lifted and light pours in. Pepe finds herself lying on the center of a stone platform.
People around her come and go as they apply sticky, pungent medicine, tightly wrapping her body with linen, constricting her attempts at movement.
Her observations are cut short when an old man walks towards her with a small knife in hand. Pepe would have panicked, but the sedative starts to take effect.
She feels someone holding her head down, and the tiny blade inches towards her forehead...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Is this what Zubayr went through?)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (When they transferred his consciousness... he was still alive.)

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Is it over? Is this what you wanted to show me, Zubayr?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Tell me, what else did you go through?

a.text: After quelling the rebellions for my brother, I bade farewell to my sister and ventured alone into this desert. Here, I stood guardian over the treasure Father entrusted to me, awaiting the arrival of a Nightzmora descendant.
Yet, through the long centuries of change, the Nightzmoran have forgotten Father's promise to Kharanduu Khagan. They never came—even when I was vanquished and sealed beneath the sands.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: And you spent nearly a thousand years just waiting here?

a.text: I have witnessed lives come into being and pass away, cities rise and fall. With prosperity comes decline, and with life comes death—an inevitability for all.
And with each end comes a new beginning, the cycle repeating endlessly.
Father was right; everything that transpires is but a continual 'time loop,' and the future is naught but a repetition of the past.
I began to hate myself for choosing to become eternal.
I wished to forget, but my sophisticated memory system prevented me from doing so. It kept my experiences fresh and vivid in my mind, every detail distinctly clear.
Pepe, you once told me you wished to become one who remembers history, both written and unrecorded. You wish to witness the truth behind the history with your own eyes.
But that comes with a price, Pepe.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Tell me, Zubayr. In your long life, even with the unbearable suffering you've been through, did you ever consider forgetting your father or sister?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: That's my answer too.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: We should remember the things that shouldn't be forgotten, even if they bring us pain.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'm... back.
There is no gigantic, ferocious beast, moist rainforest, or scorching sandstorm.
In the middle of the street sits only a small animal, casually licking its fur.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Why did you bring me inside Zubayr's memories?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It was a test he set for you. You could only see him if you passed it.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Was he the one talking to me inside the illusion?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No, that was actually me. Though the question was indeed his.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Did I pass?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You failed, so just run off back to wherever you came from, little girl.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: He seemed pretty satisfied with my answer though?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No, you just imagined it!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I have to see him. He's the one who started the unrest in the city, so only he can stop it.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Besides... he's the only one who can help me reach the City of Gold, so I can't miss this last chance.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Silly girl. Do you think being the Historian of Shar-Agade is a good thing?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You serve at the hand of the Shahanshah, and so your tongue is cut out to ensure you can never speak his secrets.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You write only what the Shahanshah wants written. You are no longer yourself, only a gilded mouthpiece.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Is this what you want, foolish girl?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Where did you learn all that? The City of Gold isn't a place some random animal can wander into.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Foolish girl, my first human pet was Lugalszargus's own daughter!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I saw with my own eyes when the poor girl had her tongue cut out by her very brother!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What?!
Enough, Mio.
She has passed Zubayr's test. Speak no more and let her pass.

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: He awaits you at the second-last house in the third alley from here. Remember this, once you enter, knock thrice on the left door, then push the right door open.

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: You will see him there.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Insolent cur, she didn't pass the test! Why did you tell her!

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: She passed the test, Mio. Enough of this.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: She did not if I say so! She failed!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You fool, do you want this girl to...?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Release me!

steps.name: Woof
steps.text: Our mission is complete! Let's go!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mroaw—!
Woof grabs Mio by the scruff and disappears down the alley, leaving behind only drag marks.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Phew... Third alley, second-last house...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Knock thrice on the left door...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: And then open the right...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: We meet again, Pepe.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Question. Would I have found you if I didn't follow the instructions exactly?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Actually, you would have found me no matter which door you opened. The key is whether you truly wish to meet me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Zubayr, I've come here with a hammer.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Do you intend to intimidate me with force?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I can't promise I won't use it.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: We don't have much time left, so just answer my questions. Truthfully.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Ask your questions, Pepe. I will answer them faithfully—not out of fear, but because it is my choice.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Have you found the fourth gemstone?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Yes. Someone was keeping it safe for me. Their family passed it down through the generations, waiting for the day I would awaken and return.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Did you decide to destroy the entire city the moment you got it? The whole place is in chaos because of the jewel constructs.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Pepe, I apologize for what is happening to the city, but I have to do it. My duty compels me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: 'Fourth, the liver. We go into the night, awake and alert, for duty and obligation.' Are your memories related to your duties complete?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: So where's the Shah's treasure trove?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Right below our feet, underneath the city of Menat-Ha'mait.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: You could say this city was founded by, and is prosperous because of the infinite treasures left behind by Father.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: When he left us, I had his cenotaph built in the deepest reach of his trove, so that it may also serve as his tomb.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: For centuries they kept digging underground, and every artifact or treasure they found in the mausoleum became fuel for the city.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: This is my fault, but it is not too late. There is still a chance to stop it, as they have yet to dig into its depths... for the treasure that mustn't be touched by the wrong hands.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: What is that exactly?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Patience, Pepe. I was just about to show it to you.
A beam of sunlight pierces through the window, illuminating the floor beside Zubayr's feet.
He raises his staff high, and suddenly a strong wind stirs from nowhere. The sistrum chimes as it jingles.
Pepe hears Zubayr hum a tune that feels familiar, though its cryptic lyrics elude her understanding.
She then feels the ground beneath her feet soften, her ankles sinking into a flowing sea of sand.
As Zubayr finishes his tune, he plunges the staff into the ground.
In an instant, sand and dust swirl wildly, enveloping them both until they vanish.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Water! Bring some water!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Hurry! Your curator spoke too much and is having a heatstroke!
Bad news, Medjehtiqedti Hanim—I'm afraid the museum hasn't had running water for a while now.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Or to be more precise, sand is pouring out of the taps. Can't even stop it.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: ...Do you work here? I don't recognize you...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: No, wait, sand... pouring from the taps?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Yep. By the way, we met your staff at the entrance and he asked me to pass on this leave request and a bunch of books.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: It was unclear where he was headed.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: The river water is too muddy to be used, and all the nearby water channels are full of nothing but sand.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: And all of these happened while we made our way here. As quickly as a rising tide...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Talk about a Flood Festival, only it's sand.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: ...Hey, Hanim? Why'd you turn so quiet? Bad time to make witty comments I see.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Anat! Anat! Wake up, hurry!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: W-We're... WE'RE GOING TO DIE!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: You've only just realized that? After everything that's happened today?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Medjehtiqedti Hanim, could you explain what's going on?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: To put it simply, if every gem in the city can be removed from its place, then the ones used for water purification are no exception.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: If too many of them are removed, the water purification system will stop working, changing the internal pressure and causing sand to intrude.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...If this happens, the constructs will have an endless supply of sand to build their pillars and walls, ruining the city.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Also, Titi... I'm worried about something worse...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Such a sudden pressure change will almost certainly damage the city's ancient underground river canal system.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I didn't want to mention it, for fear of it coming true! Now I'm really scared of this city!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Go on, what happens when the underground canals are damaged?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: A large volume of water will seep out and loosen the sand, forming quicksand.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: The whole city will sink underground, and the modern materials the constructs can't use will be buried deep down in the earth.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: And this is just speculation... but the constructs have been building their pillars and walls for a specific reason.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: They're trying to recreate the way the place looked in their memories.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: We, along with centuries of urban landscape, will be buried beneath the sands.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: ...Do you need me to elaborate further?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Nah, I got you.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: If this city sinks under the sand, everyone dies, including my crew. We're royally screwed.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: So, there's only one path I can take to keep them safe, yes?
